input_contract: audio and fixed type definitions; no gold intent, no gold-selected menu
rule: For each configured type, require its own expressed-role evidence, presence policy and scope. The same expression may support multiple true predicates when each definition is satisfied and no explicit task rule excludes that overlap.
no_automatic_closure: A type hierarchy, shared word, native positive or external real-world identity does not automatically establish another predicate.
no_automatic_exclusion: A native single-span label or lack of coannotation does not establish semantic exclusivity.
classification_order: Read full input and frozen definitions; determine request relevance without using native Final.
Assess each role predicate independently with evidence; multiple truths are allowed.
Apply only explicit frozen scope/exclusion rules, never priorities inferred from native frequency.
Keep ambiguity unresolved if role evidence cannot establish a boolean; do not resolve ambiguity merely by allowing both.
Compare semantic proposal with native projection separately; disagreement is provenance, not automatic semantic uncertainty.
Admit supervision only under a separate reviewed release; neither agreement nor disagreement grants admission.

boundary_examples.definition_A: An explicitly identified person serving the request.
boundary_examples.definition_B: An explicitly identified author of the requested book.
boundary_examples.utterance: Find the book by Susan, the author.
boundary_examples.reason: Both definitions have explicit support; this is not a certified mapping of SLURP person/audiobook_author.

boundary_examples.definition_A: A named radio station requested for playback.
boundary_examples.definition_B: A named application used for playback.
boundary_examples.reason: Unresolved reference and role cannot be made true merely by allowing overlap.

downstream_consequences: Semantic multilabel set metrics are separate from native projection and official slot-value SLU-F1.
Complete set EM requires complete admitted labels; unknown predicates remain masked for atomic objectives.
Step-wise auxiliary rewards follow the fixed family budget even if more than one type is true.
Changing overlap policy invalidates dependent definition/review hashes; old native gold remains untouched.
Type independence does not establish intent-instance binding or accepted parameter values.
migration_scope: Design only. Existing 55-card and 89-boundary unresolved statements remain historical until individually reconciled; no blanket resolution.
